faq.subtitle: Help center
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about ordering, shipping, returns, products, and support.
faq.q_createAccount: Do I need an account to place an order?
faq.a_createAccount: Yes, creating an account allows you to track orders, manage returns, and save your preferences. Registration is quick and free.
faq.q_payment: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_payment: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All transactions are secured with SSL encryption.
faq.q_cancelOrder: Can I cancel or modify my order?
faq.a_cancelOrder: You can cancel or modify your order within 1 hour of placing it. After that, please contact our support team and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.
faq.a_whereShip: We ship across Europe and to North America. Delivery times vary by region — typically 3-5 business days for EU and 7-12 days for international orders.
faq.a_shippingCost: Shipping is free on orders over €100. For orders under €100, a flat rate of €6.95 applies within Europe and €12.95 for international shipments.
faq.a_deliveryTime: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days within Europe. Express delivery (1-2 days) is available at checkout for an additional fee.
faq.q_tracking: How can I track my order?
faq.a_tracking: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email. You can also check your order status in your account dashboard.
faq.a_returnPolicy: We offer a 30-day return policy on all unused items in their original packaging. Sale items can be returned within 14 days.
faq.q_startReturn: How do I start a return?
faq.a_startReturn: Log in to your account, go to your order history, and select the item you'd like to return. Follow the instructions to generate a prepaid return label.
faq.a_refundTime: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item. The refund will appear on your original payment method.
faq.q_warranty: Do your products come with a warranty?
faq.a_warranty: All Outlander products come with a 2-year warranty covering manufacturing defects. Some premium items include extended 5-year warranties.
faq.q_sleepingBag: How do I choose the right sleeping bag?
faq.a_sleepingBag: Consider the temperature rating, fill type (down or synthetic), weight, and packed size. Our sleeping bags range from summer (0°C) to extreme winter (-30°C). Check the product specifications for detailed guidance.
faq.q_crampons: Are your crampons compatible with all boots?
faq.a_crampons: Our crampons are available in step-in, hybrid, and strap-on bindings to fit most mountaineering boots. Check the product details for compatibility information.
faq.q_stormshield: Is the StormShield jacket really waterproof?
faq.a_stormshield: Yes! Our StormShield jackets use a 3-layer membrane with a 20,000mm waterproof rating and fully sealed seams. They're tested in extreme alpine conditions.
faq.q_waterFilter: How often should I replace my water filter?
faq.a_waterFilter: Our portable water filters are rated for approximately 1,500 liters before the cartridge needs replacement. Replacement cartridges are available in our shop.
faq.q_contact: How can I contact customer support?
faq.a_contact: You can reach us via email at support@outlandergear.com, through our AI Copilot assistant, or by calling +33 1 23 45 67 89 during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9AM-6PM CET).
faq.a_stores: We currently operate as an online-only retailer, which allows us to offer better prices. We do host pop-up events — follow us on social media for announcements.
faq.contactHint: Our support team is always happy to help. Reach out anytime.
